ios.desc:
QazETA is a digital platform for travel to and stays in Kazakhstan. Arrange the necessary services right from your smartphone, find useful information, and prepare for your trip in advance—so you don’t have to waste time on logistics once you arrive.
Available in one app:
• ETA — apply for an Electronic Travel Authorization.
• E-visa — apply for an electronic visa to Kazakhstan.
• eSIM — get a Kazakhstani phone number with mobile data and calling capabilities, all without needing to visit a retail store.
• Border crossing certificate — request an electronic document confirming your entry into or exit from the Republic of Kazakhstan.
Submit applications and provide the required information online, saving you the time and effort of visiting service provider offices.
Detailed requirements, step-by-step instructions, and helpful tips will guide you through your trip preparations and the use of these services. Should any questions arise, our 24/7 support team is ready to assist you.
Verify your identity within the app using your official document and your smartphone’s camera.
Your personal data is protected in compliance with the laws of Kazakhstan and the GDPR.
Get ready for your trip in advance—with QazETA.

quotes.text:
Kazakhstan has an app (QazETA) for its electronic travel authorization, which is required for many passport holders who want to enter under the visa-free regime.  (Perhaps it is not strictly required as one could apply for a visa instead.)

Somewhat confusingly, the iOS App Store description [0] of the app says that it is not a government app, while the rest of the internet and Kazakh government sites say that it is the official government app for the purpose of applying for the ETA.

[0]: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748705452
